_about: Template for the regression test's reference data. Copy this file to
'reference_data.json' and fill in your own sessions (that file is
gitignored, so session and driver names never reach the repository).
Key   = path to the .ld file, relative to this file's folder.
Value = the 'Corr Dist [m]' read from MoTeC i2 for that session.
Missing .ld files are SKIPPED by the test, so the repository stays
portable and needs no logs committed to it.
